text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Heeey, Doto! Happy birthday to you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And the present is~~... A bracelet 
matching mine!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Whaaaat!? You mean that c-c-cute 
one you wear when you go out!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's wear them together and go 
out!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, I promise to take super good care of 
it so it never gets damaged or dirty~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoopee! But keeping it tucked away 
forever would be so lonely, yes?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Even when I'm not by your side, please 
think of it as me and take it out with 
you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Taiki-san... Yes, ma'am! On trips, on 
training camps— I'll wear it wherever I 
go...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, thank you, Doto! I'm so happy, it 
feels like we're always together♪"
